rows.note: Replace melt/undo with unfold/spread out; toolbox-panel action rather than editing tools.
Replace gather/assemble with fold; inverse of unfold, not a tool merge.

grammar: Preserve existing topic-label structure (plural tools followed by colon) and use singular imperatives addressing the user. The imperative is not pluralized to agree with tools. No new noun/annexation claim is introduced. Authored UI extension of physical fold/unfold, not attested complete UI strings.
